summary: Multiplies two 4x4 matrices stored as float[16] arrays (a2 and a3), writing the 16-element product into a1 and returning a1. If a1 aliases either operand, the product is computed into a temporary stack buffer and copied back into a1 (0x40 bytes) afterward, making the call safe for in-place use.

local_names.v4: effective destination (a1 or stack temp buffer)
local_names.v5: stack temp buffer for alias-safe output

operations.description: If the destination a1 aliases either operand (a1 == a2 or a1 == a3), redirect all output writes to a stack temporary buffer instead of the destination.
Compute the 4x4 matrix product; each of the 16 output elements is the dot product of one row of a2 with one column of a3 (or the equivalent column-major/operand-order variant of the same multiply).
Write output matrix element at this+0x0: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x4: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x8: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0xC: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x10: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x14: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x18: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x1C: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x20: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x24: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x28: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x2C: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x30: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x34: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x38: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
Write output matrix element at this+0x3C: dot product of a2 row terms with a3 column terms.
If the destination was redirected to the temp buffer, copy 64 bytes (0x40) from the buffer back into a1.
Return a1, the output matrix pointer (ABI lead name Matrix4x4Multiply).

clean_pseudocode: if (a1 == a2 || a1 == a3) dest = temp_buffer;
unresolved: Storage layout (row-major vs column-major) of the float[16] matrices is not established from the packet alone.
Whether the multiply is a2*a3 or a3*a2 depends on the unresolved layout convention; only the dot-product structure is established.
No callers or callees are recorded in the packet, so no caller-arg context exists to pin the operand roles.
